maddeler.e:
اختفين (form VIII)
# اِخْتَفَيْنَ (iḵtafayna) /ix.ta.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اُخْتُفِينَ (uḵtufīna) /ux.tu.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اِخْتَفِينَ (iḵtafīna) /ix.ta.fiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
